items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: the band we had when we left here we left here with with Joy Morris on trombone the manager and Mack on trumpet the leader and Edmund Washington on clarinet and me on banjo

ctx.x: and I was telling you how I actually got to play banjo like my brother bought a banjo and I was teaching him and I finally he got discouraged and I started taking the banjo and well this fellow George Morris and Thomas Mack they were taking lessons from Mack with the trumpet player and Joy with the trombone player and I had another fellow named I believe his name was Edmund Washington taking Clannery a very good reading Clannery player mm-hmm well uh I used to go to their house in rehearsal you see and when they…
